test_title: PYST 54: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 08 Sept, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which amendment granted constitutional status to Panchayati Raj institutions?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Seventy-third Amendment Act, 1992**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Seventy-third Amendment Act, 1992** gave constitutional status to Panchayati Raj institutions in India.
 
• This amendment added **Part IX** to the Indian Constitution, titled "The Panchayats," and introduced **Articles 243 to 243-O**.
 
• The Act also introduced the **Eleventh Schedule**, which contains 29 functional items related to Panchayati Raj institutions.
 
• The objective of the amendment was to enhance **grassroots democracy** and empower rural self-government in India.
 
• The Act mandates a **three-tier system of Panchayati Raj** for states, including Gram Panchayat, Panchayat Samiti, and Zila Parishad, except in states with populations below 2 million.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Seventy-fourth Amendment Act, 1992**

 
 
• This amendment granted **constitutional status to Urban Local Bodies** (municipalities).
 
• It added **Part IX-A** to the Constitution, titled "The Municipalities," and introduced Articles 243-P to 243-ZG.
 
• The Act also introduced the **Twelfth Schedule**, which contains 18 functional items related to urban governance.
 
• The objective was to strengthen local urban governance and ensure democratic decentralization in urban areas.
 
 
 
• **Eighty-sixth Amendment Act, 2002**
 
 
• This amendment made education a **fundamental right** under Article 21A of the Constitution.
 
• It mandated free and compulsory education for children aged **6 to 14 years**.
 
• It also amended Article 45 to promote early childhood care and education and added **Article 51A(k)**, which places a duty on parents to provide education to their children.
 
 
 
• **Seventy-second Amendment Act, 1992**
 
 
• This amendment was related to providing **reservation of seats in the Tripura State Legislative Assembly** for Scheduled Tribes.
 
• It aimed to resolve the longstanding issues of representation and ensure political participation for Scheduled Tribes in Tripura.
